findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 22 December 2025.
The only insolvency case on record is a members' voluntary liquidation, with the company wound up on 20 May 2025 and dissolved on 22 December 2025.
The accounts are of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded, and the last accounts were made up to 31 December 2023.
The confirmation statement is of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded, and was last made up to 5 March 2025.
One current director was appointed on 11 May 2022, and that director is linked to 11 other companies, of which 1 is in liquidation.
One corporate person with significant control is recorded, CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, holding ownership of shares of 75 to 100 percent.
No charges are registered against the company.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 302 (91000303) is dissolved, having ceased on 22 December 2025 after a members' voluntary liquidation that began with winding up on 20 May 2025.
